Further coded passages: Box 3 f.1 (1888-89, many coded passages obliterated with ink), Box 3 f.2 (1890-93), Box 2 f.3-6 and Box 7 (occasional coded phrases). The lead's span 1866-1902 is the whole collection; the fully coded diaries are 1891-1900.
seen.cipher: Finding aid, Collection Note: 'Others (Boxes 4 and 5) are handwritten in code, a mostly character-for-character substitution cipher with a few special characters for common combinations of letters. Some also have notations relating to Vance's accounts. No decipherment is written on or with the diaries themselves; the samples and key are filed separately in Box 6.

seen.cipher: Archive record, full title: 'Chiffren (u. a. aus den Papieren des Grafen von Wackerbarth; aus den Papieren des Gesandten Le Fort zu Petersburg; zwei Bogen Chiffren von der Gesandtschaft zu Wien herruehrend; chiffres a l'usage du ministre N. de Suhm; Berliner Gesandtschaft; Chiffren aus den 1790er Jahren in einem polnische Angelegenheiten betreffend Paket gefunden, in dem sich aber keine chiffrierten Schriften befanden), Bd. 14. Archivaliensignatur: 10026 Geheimes Kabinett, Nr. Loc. 03234/07. Kontext: ... >> 035.006. Chiffren. Laufzeit: ohne Datum.' This describes cipher alphabets of several missions; the record itself says the 1790s Polish packet contained no ciphered documents. No ciphered letter or decipherment is described.
